player_prompt.intro:
I ni jεgε {player_id} ye Chopsticks. Ni i ka tεmε, tafacogo kelen ye:
  + Kale:  '[attack M O]'  ka M=i ka liman (0 walima 1), O=kɔnɔ liman (0 walima 1).
    - Kɔnɔ liman kɔnɔ bɔyɔra i ka liman; ni a ≥5, a bɛɛ bɛɛ 0.
  + Fari:   '[split L R]'  ka i ka kɔnɔ bɔyɔrɔ L ani R (L+R = i ka kɔnɔ bɔyɔrɔ).
Kɛlɛ ni kelen ye o kɔmandi wɛrɛw.

invalid_move.split_no_change: Split bɛ se ka i bolow tilan cogo yɛlɛma.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Jɛkɔrɔba jɛkɔrɔ. Sɛbɛn na “[attack M O]” wa “[split L R]”.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} kɛ {opp_id} kɔnɔnɛ {opp_idx}: a bɛ a to {opp_val} si {new_val}.

outcome.draw: A yɛlɛma dan ye se ka kɛ.
